baselineManifest.probabilityProtocol: Existing DC + Poisson-xG family ensemble and historical as-of supplementary context. Calibration and decision filtering are downstream, shared for A/C.
baselineManifest.matrixProtocol: Joint proxy: DC + Poisson-xG with the configured default ensemble weight. If family weights differ, this proxy is not identical to every A flat marginal; official A market evaluation uses baselineProbabilities.

limitations: The current replica is retrained development code, not the frozen C906 artifact.
Original 745 protected targets were excluded before all split and selection operations.
Calendar features count only completed matches with available results; unseen fixtures are not invented.
Historical result-delay assumptions do not establish actual provider capture times.
No economic performance or promotion is inferred from probability metrics.
The depth-5 C906 recipe control is retrained retrospectively, not the frozen C906 artifact or a production candidate.
Current-page captures establish source disagreement, not cryptographic proof of historical first-seen availability.
Quarantine never replaces archive timestamps, scores, xG or statistics, and does not certify the remaining archive.
The policy applies only to explicitly tagged C inputs; operational A and previously frozen model inputs remain unchanged.
A court-awarded result is not silently treated as the played result or as bookmaker settlement evidence.
